doc: Global-state initializer. (1) Sets D_80073738 (s16) = 0x7F. (2) Loops 32 entries of D_80085FA8[] (stride 0x50): zeroes most fields, sets f2c=1, f3c=0x78, f49=0xFF. (3) For i in [0, D_80073734[0]): if (u16)D_80085458[i].f06 < 0x10, initializes that 0x78-byte entry (f00=i, f18/f70/f74=0x40, rest 0), reads tmp=D_80073740[i], calls func_80056DB4(i), OR-accumulates tmp into acc, calls func_8005E97C(0, tmp). (4) Loops 16 entries of D_80084960[] (stride 0x9C): sets f04/f1c=0x40, f0c/f14/f20/f24=0x7F, zeroes the rest. (5) Calls func_8005E97C(0, acc). tmp=D_80073740[i] is read into a local BEFORE the func_80056DB4 call (survives it and is reused); func_80056DB4's return is discarded.
